text: Riffkit for DSH 是面向 DSH 技能系统的插件包：它通过 bundle patch 将包内 riffkit 技能目录注册为独立的 skill root，让 DSH agent 能调用 Riffkit 制作短视频。技能支持基于 TikTok 链接、用户上传视频或已分析模板改编视频，也可保留原镜头进行 Swap 翻拍，或从文字创意生成原创视频；还可设置数字角色、产品植入、语言与视频输出选项。适合希望把短视频结构转化为自有故事、制作产品宣传或 UGC 风格广告的 DSH 用户。使用前需安装 Riffkit CLI 并登录获批的账户；该包本身不声明额外 API key 配置。

Riffkit for DSH registers a video making skill in DSH. It adapts a TikTok link, uploaded clip, or template, swaps people or products while keeping source shots, or creates a video from written direction. Requires the Riffkit CLI and approved account login.
我想把一个热门短视频的节奏和情绪结构改编成自己的新视频。
能不能保留原片镜头，只替换里面的人或产品？
我只有一个创意方向，想直接生成一条原创短视频。
帮我用自己的产品做一条适合社交媒体发布的 UGC 广告视频。
Turn the emotional structure of a viral clip into a new short video about my own idea.
Create an original short video from a written creative direction.
Riffkit for DSH 的功能「短视频改编」：分析来源视频的情绪公式并将其转化为用户自己的故事。用户可提供 TikTok 链接、上传视频或已分析模板作为素材，再选择 Adapt 模式生成新内容。
Riffkit for DSH 的功能「Swap 翻拍」：以来源视频为基础保留镜头、剪辑与时序，只替换人物、产品或场景。用户给出来源视频并指定要改变的内容，输出沿用原片结构的翻拍视频。
Riffkit for DSH 的功能「创意生成」：无需来源视频，依据用户写下的创意方向制作原创短视频。用户提供文字方向并选择输出设置，技能通过 Riffkit 的视频流程创建成片。
Riffkit for DSH 使用前须知：技能要求安装 Riffkit CLI 并通过 `riffkit login --agent` 登录，用户需完成授权后才能继续调用工作流。
让 DSH 根据一个 TikTok 视频的创意节奏，帮我做一条自己的短片。
Make a product promo that follows the pacing of a short video I like.

@riffkit/dsh-plugin README · Riffkit for DSH：The [Riffkit](https://riffkit.ai) agent skill, packaged as an installable
[DSH](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/dsh) bundle.

```bash
dsh plugin add @riffkit/dsh-plugin
```

Riff a winning short video into your own: Riffkit studies why a video worked —
the hook, the pacing, the emotional beats — and rebuilds that formula as new
footage with your product, your character and your language. The source clip is
never re-uploaded; what carries over is the structure, not a single frame.

@riffkit/dsh-plugin README · What this package is：A packaging layer, nothing more. It ships one thing — the skill — and registers
its own directory as an additional skill root through `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: riffkit-skill-root
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
      config:

@riffkit/dsh-plugin README · What this package is：It **inserts** its own provider row rather than editing the base one, because a
patch replaces a targeted row's whole config instead of merging into it —
overriding would wipe whatever you had configured there. With
`includeDefaultRoots: false` this provider sees exactly one root: its own. It
cannot shadow your skills, and yours cannot shadow it.

@riffkit/dsh-plugin README · Not using DSH?：Then you do not need this package. The skill is a single Markdown file and every
harness that reads a skills root can load it directly:

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills/riffkit
curl -sSL https://riffkit.ai/SKILL.md -o ~/.agents/skills/riffkit/SKILL.md
```

@riffkit/dsh-plugin README · Not using DSH?：That path — `~/.agents/skills` — is the shared root several harnesses scan, so
one copy registers Riffkit in all of them. See
[riffkit/skill](https://github.com/riffkit/skill) for the skill itself, examples,
and the install lines for Claude Code, Cursor and Codex.

@riffkit/dsh-plugin README · How this stays current：Nothing here is written by hand. A daily workflow pulls `SKILL.md`,
`HEARTBEAT.md` and `SKILL.json` from riffkit.ai — the single source of truth,
served from the app on deploy — derives `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`
from them (`scripts/generate.mjs`), proves the result is still discoverable by
DSH's own provider (`scripts/smoke.mjs`), and publishes any version the registry
does not have yet.
